## Provider ledger reconciliation

OpenRouter returned URL citations for 5,429 Stage 3/redemption discovery calls while omitting `server_tool_use.web_search_requests`. Migration `20260712_openrouter_web_search_fee_reconciliation.sql` conservatively recorded one $0.005 search request for each citation-bearing call and recomputed every affected run total. No citation-bearing call remains unmetered.

| Cost bucket | Calls | Reconciled spend |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Google Places contact/discovery | 3,800 | $50.8000 |
| Gemini 3.5 Flash classification | 808 | $32.6486 |
| GPT-4o mini model + web-search tool | 5,429 | $30.6773 |
| **Selected Stage 3 + redemption total** | **10,037** | **$114.1259** |

The GPT-4o-mini bucket comprises $3.5323 of model-token cost plus $27.1450 of web-search tool fees. Total model-token spend across both models is $36.1809, below the $500 LLM ceiling. The contact ledger finished $0.8000 above its $50 ceiling because the restart calculation reserved exactly $50 across redemption runs but omitted Stage 3's earlier $0.8000 contact spend; all subsequent contact work is forced to agent-only mode. Cancelled runs 59 and 60 were controlled concurrency/accounting restarts, and their partial successful calls are included above.
